EVENNESS CAUTION MISATTRIBUTED (minor, conservative rather than wrong): the packet's sufficient conditions set all hopping phases to 1. Under them, the phases of kappa_v and eps_B are pure diagonal gauges: W = exp(i sum_v theta_v S_v + i phi_B * sector). The reason is that only admission at v changes S_v and only Birth changes the sector. So H is gauge-equivalent to a real matrix on the complete domain (max imaginary part after the gauge is 3.8e-16), and both diagonal arms are gauge-invariant. As a result every diagonal read, including Dq0 and DS0, is exactly even in tau, with an O(tau^4) remainder, for arbitrary complex kappa and eps_B. In the exact series all odd coefficients through tau^7 are 0. Odd terms do arise inside the wider C2 class, but only from hopping flux that cannot be gauged away: with Born conjugate-pair phases (3/5+4i/5, 5/13-12i/13, i, 1), Dq0 c9 = 9808/29258484255, which is nonzero. The packet's O(tau^3) remainder is valid but conservative, and its warning names the wrong source of possible oddness.

INFORMATIONAL (supports the packet's open item): with generic nonzero couplings the fixed-A Q1M2 sector splits into 5 coordinate-graph fragments. The main fragment has 12544 states (all 256 old plus 12288 Born). The other four are U-paired Born-only pockets of 3072 states each. In a pocket, a new-site q is written on the Born component that does not hold the carrier, the opposite old q is frozen, and unBirth can never be reached. Both arms have weight 1 in the U-invariant main fragment, so their coordinate-fragment weights match exactly; at g=0 there are 28 fragments and s0, s1 still share one. A stronger check on one manufactured tuple: the cyclic subspace K(s0) contains s1, because no eigenvalue carries both U-even and U-odd weight of s0 (smallest gap between supported eigenvalues of opposite parity 2.24e-10; float resolution about 1e-15). This is numerical and specific to that tuple, not an exact certificate. The general fragment/projector certification the packet calls open remains open.
